source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 31 December 1927, p. 12 ("Larne Urban Re-elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Nomination day was Thursday; 'the returning-officer issued a declaration that the retiring members were deemed to be elected'.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, January 1928; there was no valid nomination in any ward, so the retiring members were declared elected (Belfast News-Letter, 31 December 1927, p. 12). Citation restored to the original page: the 5 Nov re-citation pointed to an unrelated page (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
